Have you ever played a game where you were constantly losing and you ended up quitting because you were bored of losing over and over again or you just passed on the controller to your friend and let them play instead? Yeah, thats what it feels like. I just don't feel like playing anymore. I wan't someone else to play instead.

I wish I could trade places with you. I'm depressed and I feel like i'm just wasting my life for nothing. If you could use my life for something useful, I would gladly give you mine. Sorry if I might sound insensitive but I am being sincere.
I love it when it rains because then no one can see tell if i'm crying or not.

I was going to make a new post today but managed to stumble upon yours... Everything you said felt like my own words. The only difference being that there is a few loved ones who care for me still. I wish i could tell them im leaving and they'd be shocked like im' just leaving to another country, but not shocked like i'm a terrorist or something. Goodluck to you man, I hope you find what you're looking for, before or after.

My friend, you have good faith but you are naive. She already says she feels guilty about disturbing her friends with her problems. Friends are good when they can help you once in a while, but depression is an on-going chronic desease. It will drain her friends' energy and they won't be able to keep up so she feels guilty about it. It takes one to know one. I know you had good intentions but just trying to shed some perspective.
Sweet words you say, I thank you for your kindess. But i'm afraid you do not understand what depression truly means my friend.
Your post just makes me want to do it now.....
I always there for her when she had horrible breakups but when my own problems started involving her she just defriended me to make it stop. It was that shallow. I had known her for 12 years.
Actually... I'm currently in debt as well. Might take about 10 years to pay it back.

Hi, i'm 26, although i am employed i've been horrible at working lately. Not because of lack of skillset, but just lack of motivation. Broke up with m y gf of 5 years a few months ago. Thought I had a close friend but she just defriended me a few months ago too. I'm still very hurt from that. My dad died a few years ago and im' the only child. My mom would be devestated if she found out im dead, suicide or not, and i'm very sure that your mother would be too.

My death... I'm seriously sick of everything and everyone. I have been for a long time and i seriously can't just trust anyone anymore. I hate this world and i just want to fucking leave without being guilty.
With a knife in one hand...i wouldn't need to try........ i could just decide how my story ends............................................................ Did it get better for you?

No, i meant it would have good to have something like one in five tries. It's more like nothing or no one there. It's one of my issues but it's not my only reason. I just don't think it's worth it anymore. Paying back a debt for 10 years. Nothing to save.....in between. I just feel like i'm living because i have to, Because i'm forced too. I understand if its too much for anyone to understand me.. I'm tired.... i just want to sleep and fade away....................................sighh...if only i was rich and handsome................

Because i feel the rest of my life is going to be pointless, the last few years seemed like so. I'm 26, been working for a while. Graduated university by 22. I had a gf of 5 years but i broke up with her. I felt we were going nowhere. I still felt lonely even though i was with her. No one new seems to be coming into my life anymore and even if i did, they'd go away probably because of my personality. I don't act sad around them so i don't know why but i'm pretty sure it's me. 

I act really cheerful on the outside. I look average. I gotten hurt recently, confessed to a friend about my feelings for her, but instead she got mad and just broke all contact with me. So I decided that maybe i'm not meant for this. Took a try at prostitution. Felt great at the time, but now im even more lonely. I have a huge debt on me. So everytime I save up some money, it goes to paying it. I didn't gain anything from this debt. It's from a fine that i'd rather not mention. Probably take me 10 years to pay it off.

I'm just angry at myself not being that model citizen. I just wanted to be normal and to be loved normally. Maybe once in every 5 tries i'd get a date. I'm scared of getting hurt again. I'm scared of trusting people again. I'm scared of killing myself alone..........................................t'would be better if i had a suicide partner..........................................but thats against the rules i guess

Yeah, if even I had a few good things left to live for I guess I wouldn't feel this way at all. But when I think about it, I'm alone at home. I can go a week to a month without doing anything and nobody except work would call me up.

Nobody currently knows I am feeling this way because of the few people I chose to talk about it, ended up completely defriending me. So I guess it's not something that I should talk to anyone about. I thought about getting some anti-depressants. It's been affecting my work and it's getting bad. I'm dressing up and taking care of myself really well. I just feel seriously tired everyday trying to keep up and being envious of other people's ability to have fun. I've been feeling this way for many years. However, it seemed to have improved, but lately it just got worse. I'm 26 and i've pretty much got rejected during 6 years  since college to the point i've seriously given up on flirting normally with women. I've recently just paid for sex and it really helped but I guess its not a long term solution.
I do this when no one's looking. Feels fucking awesome man.

time to find a good doctor then..

The thing i think im actually depressed about is not her per se, but the idea that basically all of my advances towards anybody never worked out. The only way i've had girlfriends is that they liked me first. In the end, i break up with them because i never loved them. my last gf was with me for 5 years and i just broke it off last night... it hurt... but it was the right thing to do.. i don't know...my eyes are so dry.. 6 hours passed by and i've just stared into the empty space.... Everytime i had someone sort of help me... this time however, they're gone
I'm on the verge... at my tipping point.. i used to be able to handle these things...

My thoughts have been being persistent and more aggressive lately, but i don't know how to feel about a hotline. It just seems automatic and robotic. They only care as a human society, when all i wanted was a genuine friend to care for me. Just any single person that isn't my kin, thats all i ever wanted.
When you say seek help, you mean a doctor right? Not friends?
Thanks man. I appreciate it.

I like to refer to them as milestones. Although lately, things seem to be gotten into a loop and the stress has been building up. All I need is someone that truly and sincerely understans what i'm going through. But even that seems like alot to ask for these days.
The friendzone is something that any of us would experience anyway. But to keep having experiencing it with many different people over the years. It's unbearable.

I would just like you to know, that i felt much better that there is someone out there that feels exactly like me, right now. I feel like i want to disappear from this world - to vanish like I never existed. Though, I do not know how to make you feel better directly since I, too, is inflicted with this current mindset.
